items.title: Micron Stock Is Rising. Why It’s Not What It Seems.
items.summary: Micron Technology  was looking to end the week on a high note, but the move does little to offer investors guidance on where shares might go next.  Micron shares were up 4.3% in early trading Friday, and looked set to finish the week up more than 6%.  A chance for a decisive break higher could come when Micron reports its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings, due Sept. 30.

items.title: Stocks fall after a surprisingly strong jobs report raises prospects of an interest rate hike
items.summary: U.S. stocks fell and Treasury bond yields mostly rose Friday after the government reported that employers unexpectedly added 162,000 jobs last month.  The surprise increase in hiring could give the Federal Reserve leeway to raise its benchmark short-term interest rate to fight inflation when central bank policymakers meet later this month.  Gains in technology stocks helped limit declines in other sectors.
